headline: Mexico Job Creation Slows and Unemployment Ticks Up in Third Quarter
summary: Mexico's job creation slowed sharply in the third quarter, with new job additions dropping to 122,348 while overall employment and unemployment ticked up.
why: Labor market indicators provide essential signals regarding domestic economic momentum and consumer purchasing power in Latin America.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Slowing job creation points to a cooling domestic labor market.
